body:
WHAT
`isLocalBaseUrl` decides whether an endpoint is on this machine or the local network (localhost, *.local, 127.x, 10.x, 192.168.x, 172.16–31.x, ::1, 0.0.0.0, host.docker.internal). Such a server needs no API key. The engine uses it to allow a keyless boot; the app uses it to accept a keyless connection in the wizard. Both copies must give the same answer for every URL.

WHY
When they disagreed, the app accepted a keyless http://192.168.1.20:1234/v1 and the engine then refused to boot with 'No API key found'.

WHERE
engine/core/src/config/providerFactory.ts — `export function isLocalBaseUrl()` (also used by `endpointSpecFromSettings()` for numCtx and by engine/host/src/bootstrap.ts `bootstrapEngine()`); app/main/config.js — `function isLocalBaseUrl()` (exported).

TEST CHECKLIST
1. For each of http://localhost:11434/v1, http://gpu.local/v1, http://127.0.0.1/v1, http://10.0.0.5/v1, http://192.168.1.20:1234/v1, http://172.16.0.1/v1, http://172.31.255.1/v1, http://[::1]:8080/v1, http://0.0.0.0/v1, http://host.docker.internal:1234/v1 both functions return true.
2. For https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai, http://172.32.0.1/v1, http://172.15.0.1/v1, http://8.8.8.8/v1 and http://mylocalhost.com both return false.
3. For garbage input ('not a url', '') both return false without throwing.
4. Property-style: for a list of ~50 mixed URLs, the engine result equals the app result on every item.
5. bootstrapEngine with no key and baseUrl http://192.168.1.20:1234/v1 does NOT throw MissingApiKeyError (the engine honours the LAN rule the app accepts).
